$description: What crawlers may fetch (make web-data writes robots.txt and the sitemaps from this and the exported pages). Until apps/web/src/config/site.json sets indexing to true, robots.txt disallows everything and every page is noindex. After launch it follows dsapghuletutorials.com's robots.txt (read 2026-11-04, when it added Applebot-Extended, CloudflareBrowserRenderingCrawler and meta-externalagent to the blocked agents): search and AI answers allowed, training refused. Content-Signal is Cloudflare's published convention; Google has not said it honours it, so the blocked agents are what enforce it. Search and user-triggered agents (Googlebot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot) are not listed, so User-agent: * allows them. Google-Extended only controls Gemini training and grounding, not Search or AI Overviews. indexable: which pages of each language may be indexed once indexing is on ('all', or a list of route ids). A page outside it is noindex, left out of the sitemaps and out of every page's hreflang set, and robots.txt must still let it be crawled or Google never sees the noindex (Google robots meta tag docs). English is the reviewed language; Hindi and Marathi open only their home pages while their other pages are drafts (docs/content/status.md), so Search shows a language entry point without drafts competing with the English pages.
